metric_note: Performance is scored only after the minimum accountable runtime sample. blocked_external/cancelled are tracked but excluded from the performance index. Readiness/implementation evidence is not treated as runtime performance.

coordinator.name: Coordinator / CEO Orchestrator
coordinator.implementation_evidence: Repository state machine, TODO/CURRENT/STATE files, CI gates, and OpenClaw-facing boot protocol exist; no separately identified runtime task history is yet logged.

finance.name: Finance / Economics Agent
finance.implementation_evidence: Paper-money model, funnel economics, founder-gated Razorpay adapter, verified payment reconciliation, and revenue summary exist; verified collected cash remains INR 0.

marketing.name: Marketing Agent
marketing.implementation_evidence: Public quote funnel and source-attributed economics model exist, but verified external enquiries are zero and broad promotion is gated until deployment and monitored public contact are ready.

media.name: Media / Content Agent
media.implementation_evidence: No autonomous publisher is enabled by design; current repository has no runtime media-performance observations.

operations.name: Operations / Reliability Agent
operations.implementation_evidence: Docker/Compose, CI, non-root runtime, persistent-volume handling, backup/restore tooling, Railway runbook, and non-mutating deployment preflight are implemented and validated in sandbox.

quotation.name: Quotation / Proposal Agent
quotation.implementation_evidence: Proposal drafts, deterministic artifacts, approval state machine, secure shares, and founder-only approval enforcement are implemented and tested.

sales.name: Sales Agent
sales.implementation_evidence: Public enquiry intake, deterministic scoring, qualification, pipeline, follow-up scheduling, daily brief, audit trail, and constrained automation client are implemented and tested.

support.name: Support / Customer Success Agent
support.implementation_evidence: No dedicated customer-success workflow is implemented; building it before paid demand would not advance the current evidence bottleneck.

trading_research.name: Trading Research Agent
trading_research.implementation_evidence: The current Sales OS repository intentionally does not contain live trading execution. Any strategy-factory work remains a separate project boundary and paper-only for promotion decisions.

trading_risk_execution.name: Trading Risk / Execution Agent
trading_risk_execution.implementation_evidence: No live execution capability is part of the Sales OS repository; real-money actions are explicitly forbidden at the current evidence level.
